profile.self_view: We are an ascending civilizational power reclaiming our rightful global standing through state-guided technological self-reliance and comprehensive industrial modernization.
strengths: Unrivaled comprehensive manufacturing ecosystem and high-capacity global supply networks.
Rapidly advancing domestic technology, renewable energy, and electric vehicle industries.
Strong centralized state capacity to mobilize strategic capital and resources.
Vast domestic consumer market offering significant long-term growth potential.
weaknesses: Worsening demographic decline and shrinking productive workforce over coming decades.
Structural real estate downturn weighing on consumer confidence and balance sheets.
Tightening Western tech export controls constraining access to advanced semiconductors.
High local government debt levels constraining regional fiscal stimulus capacity.
profile.lever: Global manufacturing dominance and critical minerals

impacts.title: Advanced Technology Export Controls and Retaliation
impacts.detail: Tighter restrictions on advanced AI hardware alongside illicit workarounds and Chinese counter-restrictions on critical minerals threaten US semiconductor revenues and raise manufacturing costs across high-tech sectors.

impacts.title: Reallocation of US Foreign Treasuries Holdings
impacts.detail: Gradual diversification away from US Treasuries toward gold and bilateral trade settlements exerts upward pressure on long-term US yields, lifting corporate and consumer borrowing costs.

impacts.title: Bilateral Market Access in Key Sectors
impacts.detail: Expansion of approvals for Western pharmaceuticals and industrial products creates selective upside, while ongoing tariffs and supply-chain onshoring squeeze consumer discretionary and tech hardware margins.

profile.self_view: We remain the indispensable global superpower, driving frontier technological innovation and anchoring international financial stability through the dollar.
strengths: Global reserve currency status ensuring unmatched financial flexibility and borrowing power.
World-leading innovation ecosystem in artificial intelligence, technology, and biotechnology.
Deep, highly liquid capital markets attracting continuous international investment flows.
Continental-scale energy independence and robust domestic resource endowments.
weaknesses: Persistent fiscal deficits and elevated sovereign debt servicing burdens.
Acute political polarization threatening policy continuity and regulatory predictability.
Vulnerability to global supply chain disruptions for critical industrial inputs.
Deteriorating infrastructure alongside rising domestic entitlement spending pressures.
